replace:
for _, button in ipairs(self.buttons) do -- [AP7:auto-TopBar-lua-3]
			local rect = {ax = button_ax, ay = ay, bx = button_ax + self.size, by = by}
			local is_hover = get_point_to_rectangle_proximity(cursor, rect) <= 0
			-- [AP18: snap layouts] where the maximize button is, in window pixels (read by MainForm for WM_NCHITTEST -> HTMAXBUTTON)
			if button == self.ap_max and visibility > 0.3 then
				local rs = string.format('%d,%d,%d,%d', math.floor(rect.ax + 0.5), math.floor(rect.ay + 0.5), math.floor(rect.bx + 0.5), math.floor(rect.by + 0.5))
				if rs ~= self.ap_max_last then self.ap_max_last = rs; mp.set_property('user-data/ap/max-button', rs) end
			end
			-- [AP8: themed close button] colour comes from the active theme (AP_CLOSE, set in main.lua)
			local own_bg, own_hover = button.bg, button.hover_bg
			if button.is_close and AP_CLOSE then own_hover = AP_CLOSE.bg end   -- only lights up (theme red, never the accent) while the mouse is on it
			local opacity = is_hover and 1 or config.opacity.controls
			local button_fg = is_hover and (button.hover_fg or bg) or (button.fg or fg)
			local button_bg = is_hover and (own_hover or fg) or (own_bg or bg)

			cursor:zone('primary_click', rect, button.command)
